title: ContentManifest
description: Server-side Content Library served to agents over LAN HTTP (GET /content/{content_id}). Operator-managed files (desktop wallpapers, offline install payloads, config assets) addressed by stable content_id and verified by sha256. Agents cache under ProgramData\EsportsUtil\content\ and skip re-download when the cached hash matches — pulls are idempotent. Factory State entries reference content by content_id so baseline restores are self-contained on any PC.

content_id.description: Stable handle; factory entries and jobs reference content only by this id, never by URL or path.

sha256.description: Integrity check; agent verifies after download, cache key is this hash.

target.description: Scoping of who receives/should have this content.

target_values.description: machine_model or client_id list when target != all.
